sidebar.section_row(section_label: str, fields: list[tuple[float, str]]) → None¶

Displays information contained in fields input, named after section_label input, under the format of a 2 columns table : | section_label | field1

| field2
| ….
| fieldN

Ratios between 0 (excluded) and 1 (excluded) of trains delayed/cancelled are displayed as approximate proportions (“X out of Y trains”). Very low and very high ratios are handled separately to avoid misleading approximations. Missing values, zero ratios and invalid ratios are handled separately.

Parameters:

  • section_label (str) – Label of the section, contained in the first column.

  • fields (list) – list of fields, tuples containing a ratio and a status.

  • trains (The ratio represents the number of delayed/cancelled)

  • period. (divided by the number of planned trains over the selected)

  • column (First field is displayed in the second)

:param : :param same line as the section_label. Other fields are stacked on the following rows: :param on the second column.:

sidebar.display_delayed_cancelled_stats_table(col: str, departure_city: str, arrival_city: str, start_month: str, end_month: str, selected_years: numpy.ndarray) → None¶

Displays delayed and cancelled train ratios in the given column. The ratios are displayed as approximate fractions (“X out of Y trains”). The statistics are the ratios computed over a given months/years period, for a given departure and arrival cities.

Parameters:

  • col (str) – body column number to place the table

  • departure_city (str) – departure city to compute the statistics

  • arrival_city (str) – arrival city

  • start_month (str) – first month of the time period for a given year

  • end_month (str) – last month of the time period

  • selected_years (np.ndarray) – np.ndarray of selected years to compute the statistics
